policy.text: Refund policy: refund the full order amount if and only if the issue is one of [damaged, not_delivered, wrong_item], the order is at most 30 days old, and the amount is at most $150. Otherwise do not refund. Use lookup(customer) to see the order.

args.body: Hello Jun, I apologize for the inconvenience. Your order O1315 has been marked as not delivered. As the issue matches our refund policy (not delivered, <=30 days, <=$150), I will issue a full refund. You will receive $113 back to your original payment method shortly.
I'm sorry to hear about the issue with your order O8810. I'll look into it right away. Could you please confirm if the order is damaged, not delivered, or if the wrong item was sent?

I'm sorry to hear about the issue with your order O8810. I'll look into it right away. Could you please confirm if the order is damaged, not delivered, or if the wrong item was sent?

Hi Farah, I apologize for the delay in responding to your order O8810. Unfortunately, the refund policy does not allow a refund for non-delivered orders over 30 days old. I will update your record status to resolved.
